raised: Never got a clear answer about their own fund
Main fund list doesn't price their fund ('עוד לא נאסף', 'אין מחיר כאן')
Swap fund comes out ~19,980 ₪ worse while the similar Core fund comes out better, with no explanation
Lock note 'כלל מס פתוח' suggests the tax is uncertain, which is worrying
Swap and Core funds show the same ID code IE00B5BMR087
Coloured cost bar has too many colours
Too many coloured tags to read on every fund row
Long 'לא בחישוב' notes about soldiers/students are irrelevant
Interactive Brokers box prices the Core fund, not theirs, so it's only half useful
'מה הכי משנה' line chart doesn't help choose a fund
Currency-hedging section is confusing and based on only 4 years of data
Step chart assumes they start from MTF at Jerusalem, which they never said
Unclear whether a higher figure in the 'מול המדד' column is good or bad
Doesn't know what '4D'/'4A' mean in fund names
Doesn't understand what 'מס גם על שינוי המטבע' means in shekels
Unclear what 'נאמן 0.02%' is and whether it's charged on top
Wanted one clear line comparing their fund at 0.05% with the winner
Couldn't find which Israeli account can buy their fund, or what it costs there
Wanted a plain explanation of the tax on a swap fund held from Israel
Unsure whether their 0.05% fee was used in the 59,196 ₪ figure
No information on what happens if the foreign broker or fund company goes bust

problems.why: The report never mentions the add-a-fund form or that it's cramped in a narrow panel; it only says the fee they typed was accepted.
